title: Playboy Magazine November 1963 Jimmy Hoffa Interview Shel Silverstein Ski Cover
conditionDescription: Light toning, edge and corner wear, light spine rubbing. Covers attached, spine intact, complete. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, November 1963 issue. Cover price 75 cents. Jimmy Hoffa exclusive interview; Playboy on Skis - the U.S. ski scene coast to coast; hallucinatory drugs explored by Aldous Huxley, Alan Harrington and Dan Wakefield; "Lafcadio," a book-length fable by Shel Silverstein; the Canada pictorial. Snow-and-ski-sweater cover. Back cover carries a 1963 Noilly Prat vermouth ad.

Condition: Good for its age - cover shows light toning, edge and corner wear and a little spine rubbing; both covers firmly attached, spine intact, complete. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review all photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
